SASBDB entry SASDSX5  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDSX5/)

Publication: BCL7 proteins, novel subunits of the mammalian SWI/SNF complex, bind the nucleosome core particle
DOI:         (none recorded in SASBDB)

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDSX5/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
